messages.subject: Project Lyra - Series C term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor,

Further to our call, please find attached the draft Series C term sheet for Caspian Technologies. It reflects the headline terms we discussed - £120m pre-money, £30m round, single board seat plus observer for Marisdale.

We'd be grateful for your comments. We're working towards signature of the term sheet by month end and completion in June.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: Re: Project Lyra - Series C term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you. The structure works for us. Two points from our side: (1) we'd like the liquidation preference confirmed as senior to Series B in the cascade (looks right but please confirm in the long-form), and (2) we'll want enhanced information rights and an MFN in a side letter. Rachel Hargrove and David Lin at Hargrove & Associates will run the documents for us.

Subject to those, we're happy to sign the term sheet this week.

Best,
Eleanor
